permissions.purpose: Contact the HTTPS service for sign-in, vehicle requests, and update checks.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Show unavailable or offline state and do not claim a request succeeded. INTERNET has no runtime permission prompt; inspect device network Settings.

permissions.purpose: Identify the enrolled owner through Amazon profile:user_id in the system browser, then finish verifier-bound polling in the app.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Do not issue a device session. Show canceled or failed sign-in and allow another sign-in attempt.

permissions.purpose: Record the owner's explicit consent to access and control the enrolled vehicle.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Do not submit vehicle requests. Explain consent on opening and provide application Settings to review it.

permissions.purpose: Use an age-checked approximate phone location for local weather and sunrise/sunset shading while the app is open. Send only a rounded approximate cell to Open-Meteo. Vehicle-map tracking uses its separate precise-location grant.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Show weather unavailable if permission is denied or no recent phone fix exists. Request once automatically; a later Weather action is an explicit retry. Weather does not start the tracking service.

permissions.purpose: Use precise phone GPS in the visible foreground service after the app closes. Upload movement over 50 feet at most every two minutes to the authenticated encrypted store; substitute phone position only while synchronized with the vehicle.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Do not start phone tracking without precise permission. Keep vehicle polling and update checks available. Android Settings can restore permission.

permissions.purpose: Keep the authorized location service active with an ongoing notification after the activity closes.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Do not claim background tracking is active if the service cannot start. Reopening the app retries within Android permission rules.

permissions.purpose: Declare the location foreground-service type required by current Android versions.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Do not start the service without the required platform permission and precise-location grant.

permissions.purpose: Hold a bounded 25-second CPU wake lock during a GPS-triggered upload, never continuously.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Allow Android to suspend the upload and do not claim a position was delivered.

permissions.purpose: Show the tracking notification, optional reopen reminder, and verified-update availability from six-hour background checks.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Do not rely on notifications. Keep the update prompt on next open. Explain missing permission and offer Android application Settings; request only when the OS permits. Android versions below API 33 have no runtime prompt for this permission.

permissions.purpose: Hand an owner-approved update to the system browser and Android installer.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Keep the installed app working and preserve the update prompt on next open. Trusted-source Settings belong to the browser; this app does not request REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.

permissions.purpose: Allow the service to collect OnStar vehicle locations every 30 minutes; this does not use phone GPS.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Keep scheduled location collection paused. Preserve unrelated controls and allow consent review in application Settings.
